svg.desc: Isometric partitions and hex clusters: care. Small blocks sheltered inside a taller U, open toward us, its inner wall lit in the value's colour. After B015 Isometric Allotment (partition, hashed heights, painter's order), B018 Hex Terraces (roots reserve neighbours), B068 Soft Brutalism (flat three-tone light), B098 Terraced Reaction. Structure: ground plan. Process: hashed heights, painted back to front by x+y+z on a (7,4) (-7,4) (0,-8) lattice. Mark: paper on the subject's top, the value's colour on every lit face, ground through the shade face, 3-unit ink where faces meet. Params {W:22,D:20,t:2,h:7,small:[[3,3],[9,3],[3,9]],s:4,hs:[2,3]}. Seed rng("GEW06-care").
